_comment: Step 13.168 (stage 4 of docs/plans/catalog-volume-parts.md, docs/plans/stage4-volume-parts.md section 5), approved by the user: «فهرست نسخه‌های خطی چهار کتابخانه مشهد» (Kazem Modir Shanechi, Abdollah Nourani and Taghi Binesh, under Mohammad Taqi Danesh-Pajouh; Farhang-e Iran Zamin, 1351; MTIF 32537), volume 1 of «مجموعه فهرست نسخه‌های خطی کتابخانه‌های شهرستان‌های ایران» but cited by its own name. The registry had no source of it; its copies were on Tehran University's catalogue of microfilms. Its four parts are Fankha's rows 524, 525, 540, 518; «کتابخانه فرهنگ» has no record the copies point to, so its part has no library. Run: php artisan catalogs:import-volume-parts --data=database/data/volume_parts_chahar_ketabkhaneh_mashhad.json
